description: Tenant setting for web usage tracking — tenant admins only. aktiv (store events at all; off = nothing is stored), personenbezogen (store the user id; per-person evaluation only for admins; switching it off removes the user id from stored events), aufbewahrung_tage (retention 1-730, default 90; older events are deleted nightly), hinweis (notice text shown to employees — they must be informed before switching on). Only the given fields change.

aufbewahrung_tage.description: Retention in days (1-730, default 90); older events are deleted nightly

hinweis.description: Notice text shown to employees about the usage tracking

personenbezogen.description: Store the user ID with events; off removes it from stored events

name: set_nutzung_einstellungen
